title: Preparation of biopolymer-supported spinel cobalt ferrite with controlled composition as a peroxydisulfate activator for glyphosate-contaminated wastewater treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2378-2397
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00605H, Paper
Minh Thanh Le, Thu Hien Nguyen, Lan Huong Nguyen
Biopolymer-supported CoFe2+xO4 was synthesized and efficiently activated PS for enhanced GPS mineralization. The improvement was attributed to Co2+ regeneration by Fe enrichment, with 1O2, *SO4−, and *OH as main reactive species.
